name: Josys
summary: Josys builds a SaaS inventory from login data, browser activity and integrations, and connects to apps to track licenses and usage. Its renewal alerts are described on a vendor article rather than a product page. Pricing depends on the number of identities governed, with a 14-day trial of the full platform.

facts.text: Josys says its inventory comes from login data, browser activity and integrations, and that unauthorized apps can be flagged for approval.
Josys says it connects directly to 300+ SaaS apps to track licenses, usage and expenses, and offers a License Optimization Dashboard.
A Josys article lists automated alerts and workflows so teams do not miss a renewal date.
Josys's pricing page offers a 14-day free trial of the full platform with no credit card required.

plans.name: Platform
plans.notes: No price published. The page says price depends on the number of identities and governance needs.
